quotations.old_english: Ðe má ðe ǽnig fugel his flyhtes gewylt, gif his óðer fiðere forod bið
Man hine foredum sceancum intó þǽre eá wurpe

source_text: forod. Add :-- Gif hóhsino forod (-ad, 146, 4) sié, Lch. ii. 14, 27. Ðe má ðe ǽnig fugel his flyhtes gewylt, gif his óðer fiðere forod bið, Hml. Th. ii. 318, 29. Heora fæder feóll foredum swyran, 326, 7. Man hine foredum sceancum intó þǽre eá wurpe, Hml. S. 27, 58. v. sceanc-, un-forod.
